name: Clipboard Manager
description: Sequential multi-slot clipboard manager for KoBar. Stores your copied items in visual slots and pastes them in order.
author: KoBar
versionNote: Slots now sit as one block between the Copy and Paste buttons: 2/3/4 rows by density in both vertical and horizontal bars, no overlap with other icons. On the new KoBar, rapid back-to-back Ctrl+V presses are no longer skipped; if a paste fails the item is put back.
